pages.title: Spicy Placenta
pages.text: New York is the twelfth and last race in Skitchin', 8.9 miles long, and Spicy Placenta is its song. When the reviewer for Hyper magazine went through the song titles, this one got a single comment: "Spicy Placenta - yeeurck!" The password for New York is LIBERTY.

pages.title: How skitching got its name
pages.text: Skitching got its name in New York, from a journalist who saw skaters hanging on to cars and trucks there. Dave Ralston and designer Dave Warfield both read the article, and each of them pitched the game at EA's weekly meeting.
